acceptance_criteria.criterion: http://localhost:3420/ loads without JavaScript errors in the browser console

Clicking Delete shows a native confirmation dialog before proceeding

Project detail shows the WP summary table; clicking a WP row navigates to WP detail
WP detail shows pipelines, acceptance criteria (with met/unmet state), and handoff notes

ledger_root field is read-only and not sent on save

comments.note: WP summary rows in renderProjectDetail initially used wp.id but WorkPackageSummarySchema uses work_package_id. Fixed before live testing.

Auto-refresh interval is stored as Router._activeInterval and cleared in Router.dispatch() before each view transition. This prevents phantom callbacks from the project list view executing after navigation.
escapeHtml() is applied on all user-supplied data before HTML interpolation throughout all view functions. All fetch API calls handle errors with user-facing showError() calls.

comments.note: No ES modules (no import/export). All code in global scope using var declarations and IIFE (API, Router). Compliant with constraint.
Router._setPolling() exposes an internal detail via underscore-prefixed property. This is pragmatic for a single-file plain JS app but slightly breaks encapsulation. Low-priority debt.

renderProjectDetail WP table shows work_package_id as both ID column and Title column (the Title field doesn't exist in WorkPackageSummary). This is a data model limitation — WP summaries don't carry a title field. Acceptable given the schema.
No observations blocking the merge — code is clean, well-commented, follows spec, XSS protections are applied consistently.
